description: This file defines a class 'MobileBundleTableConfigResolver' that configures and manages the behavior of a mobile app bundle table in an Angular application, including fetching data, handling row clicks, editing bundles, and configuring cell actions.

classes.name: MobileBundleTableConfigResolver
classes.description: An Angular service class that provides configuration for a mobile app bundle table, including data fetching, row handling, editing, and actions.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for mobile app bundles.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Sets up cell action descriptors, such as configuration app action.

methods.name: editBundle
methods.description: Opens a dialog to edit or add a mobile app bundle, returning an observable of the bundle.

methods.name: configurationApp
methods.description: Opens a dialog to configure the app, fetching related app info before opening.
